title: Intersection number as a multivariate Euler-characteristic coefficient
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a proper $k$-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism] of dimension $g$, and let $\mathcal L$ be an ample invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-sc-ample]. The top self-intersection number $(\mathcal L^g\cdot X)$ is the coefficient of $n_1\cdots n_g$ in the polynomial $\chi(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes(n_1+\cdots+n_g)})$ in the variables $n_1,\ldots,n_g$.

mathlib_searches.query: coefficient of n_1 through n_g in Euler characteristic polynomial defines intersection number
